answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 63 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in violet, queued in trellis, and sonnet publishes the wait time. A farm of 362 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4413 identities would post 547 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
